en: Il est trois heures. What time is it?
Trois heures means three o’clock, with no minutes added.
How do you say ’It is 5 o’clock’?
French tells the time with Il est and the word heures.
Il est huit heures et demie. What time is it?
Et demie means half past, so it is half past eight.
Il est deux heures et quart. What time is it?
Et quart means a quarter past the hour.
Il est six heures moins le quart. What time is it?
Moins le quart means a quarter before the hour, so a quarter to six.
Il est midi. What time is it?
Midi is twelve o’clock in the middle of the day.
Il est minuit. What time is it?
Minuit is twelve o’clock in the middle of the night.
How do you say ’It is one o’clock’?
Heure is feminine, so we say une, and there is no s for just one hour.
How do you say ’half past four’?
Il est dix heures dix. What time is it?
Minutes after heures are added on, so dix heures dix is ten past ten.
Il est sept heures moins dix. What time is it?
Moins dix means ten minutes before seven.
Il est neuf heures vingt. What time is it?
Neuf heures is 9 o’clock and vingt adds twenty minutes: 9:20.
Il est onze heures cinq. What time is it?
Onze heures is 11 o’clock and cinq adds five minutes: 11:05.
Il est quatre heures moins vingt. What time is it?
Twenty minutes before four o’clock is 3:40.
Il est midi et demi. What time is it?
half past twelve in the day
Midi is noon and et demi means half past. After midi we write demi with no e.
Il est sept heures et demie.
Il est sept heures et demi.
Il est sept heure et demie.
Heures is feminine, so demie ends in e, and heures has an s.
Quelle heure est-il ? What does it mean?
Heure means hour or time, so the question asks the time.
How do you ask ’What time is it?’ in French?
Quelle heure est-il ? asks the time. The others ask about age and weather.
School starts at 8:30. L’école commence à ___.
8:30 is half past eight, which is huit heures et demie.
Je mange à midi. When do I eat?
Midi means twelve o’clock in the day.
To say at a time, French uses à: à six heures.
Le matin. What does it mean?
Le matin is the morning, the start of the day.
Le soir. What does it mean?
Le soir is the evening, near the end of the day.
Après means after, so l’après-midi is after midday.
It is 2:15. Il est deux heures ___.
Fifteen minutes past is a quarter past, which is et quart.
It is 9:45. Il est ___ heures moins le quart.
9:45 is a quarter to ten, so we say dix heures moins le quart.
Il est cinq heures du matin. What time is it?
Du matin means in the morning, so it is 5 a.m.
Il est quinze heures. What time is it?
French clocks often use 24 hours. Quinze heures is 15:00, which is 3 p.m.
Il est vingt heures. What time is it?
Vingt heures is 20:00 on the 24-hour clock, which is 8 p.m.
Which word is missing? Il ___ dix heures.
We tell the time with Il est, from the verb être.

example.q_en: Il est trois heures. What time is it?
example.why_en: Trois heures means three o’clock, with no minutes added.

en.title: Telling the time in French
en.teach: To tell the time, say Il est, then the hour and heures: Il est trois heures (3 o’clock). Add et quart, et demie or moins le quart for the quarters and halves.
